visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man seen from behind is walking on a paved urban sidewalk. He is wearing a beige hoodie and black pants. He accidentally drops a cluster of keys on the ground. The camera pans down to a close-up of the keys resting on the concrete tiles. (2) A second man, wearing a black t-shirt and a purple New Era cap with a Lakers logo, stops and points at the keys. He looks up at the first man with a surprised facial expression, pointing and shouting. (3) The scene shifts to a fast-paced montage. We see extreme close-ups of the beige hoodie, focusing on a red and white flame graphic on the sleeve, the bold 'FOOD ADDICT' text on the chest, and a silver zipper being pulled up. The man in the purple cap looks transfixed, with digital pink heart icons appearing around his face as he smiles. (4) The first man turns around to face the camera. He has brown hair and is wearing the beige hoodie. He speaks directly to the man in the purple cap with an assertive expression. (5) Suddenly, the man in the purple cap is wearing the same beige hoodie. He is seen performing energetic dance-like movements and poses on the sidewalk. He smiles widely and looks confident. (6) A final still image appears, showcasing a black version of the same 'FOOD ADDICT' hoodie with blue flame graphics. Promotional text overlays the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with the sharp, metallic impact of a cluster of keys hitting the ground. A male voice shouts 'Xiansheng' with high arousal and a rising pitch contour to get someone's attention. A funky hip-hop background music track begins, featuring a strong electronic beat and synthesizer bass. (2) A comic 'ping' sound effect occurs as the scene transitions. Another male voice responds with an aggressive and defensive tone, utilizing sharp articulation. The background music maintains a constant high-energy tempo with rhythmic electronic drums. (3) A series of rapid impact sound effects and transition whooshes correlate with close-up shots. The music swells in volume, creating an upbeat and cool vibe. The foley sound of a zipper being pulled up is clearly audible above the music bed. (4) The audio shifts to a professional narrative style. A voice-over describes product features with clear enunciation and moderate speed. The background music continues with a prominent rhythmic bassline. Sound effects of fabric rustling and footsteps are mixed in as characters move. (5) The track concludes with a final energetic stinger sound effect and a rhythmic fade-out of the hip-hop beat, providing a clean technical resolution to the promotional segment.
